title: Update third-party notices for mimalloc and current locked dependencies
outcome: Bring the third-party notice inventory up to date, including both mimalloc Rust packages and bundled native C notices.
acceptance: The inventory includes the versions and applicable notices for mimalloc, libmimalloc-sys and the bundled Microsoft mimalloc C library shipped by the allocator change.
The existing inventory is reconciled against the current Cargo.lock and distribution contents; its declared package count and omitted direct dependencies are corrected.
The update preserves applicable copyright and license texts from the corresponding versioned upstream packages and identifies any dependency-specific distribution obligations.
